parts.name: probe camera: Arducam 12MP autofocus USB in its metal case (B0FLX58WKZ; bracket off)
parts.note: nods with the cradle about the SG90's axis from -20 to +90 deg; parked 15 deg up it is the front camera, lens (28, 0, 123), 61 x 50 deg, autofocus 10 cm to inf, 1080p 30 live, 12 MP stills; the case is its heat spreader (Spark 9 Nov); 36 square, under ~18 deep (14 Nov coupon C: it fits the 18.6 gap), drawn 18; held in a sleeve by its own side screws, its front on the sleeve's lip, so its depth never matters

parts.name: probe camera cradle (drawn prototype, parts/scout_v4_cradle/make.py)
parts.note: a square sleeve round the case's four sides (36.9 inside), 12 long, open front and back, a lip on its front rim outside the lens, a slot along each side at mid-height through which the camera's own side screws (its bracket's, up to M3) clamp it wherever the holes are; any depth 12..18 (14 Nov, coupon C), the lens fixed by the lip; 15 Nov prototype (the camera had no way in, it would not go on the frame): open behind (the case slides in past the axis), the LED bars on through their windows, side walls 3.35 with the horn's arm in a channel open at the bottom edge (it drops onto the horn, two horn screws), the idler's A1 3.3 bore; PCTG

parts.name: probe light: two 25 x 8 mm bars of Clearhill 5 V COB strip, 4000 K, CRI 90 (B0F1YPP6QS)
parts.note: stuck on the camera case's top and bottom fronts (the metal case is their heat sink; no fins), 25 mm is the strip's cut length; ~0.2 W a bar at 8 W/m; on the DRV8833's B channel, DC or PWM >= 20 kHz

parts.name: probe tilt servo: SG90 (DORHEA, B0DFKPVRC2) and its 470 uF capacitor
parts.note: its shaft on the tilt axis facing -y, held by its 32.8 tabs on the head frame's +y pads; the capacitor on its lead covers its > 1 A start

parts.name: the SG90's single-arm horn and its centre screw (from its bag), screwed to the cradle's +y wall
parts.note: on the SG90's spline, its arm in the cradle's channel (parts/scout_v4_head_lib.py): it turns with the cradle

parts.name: probe head frame: the clip on the blades' tip, the SG90's closed ring, the idler's bracket (drawn prototype, parts/scout_v4_head_frame/make.py)
parts.note: a 14 mm sleeve round the lens: blade A held by an M2 at its top, blade B's M2 in a 12 mm slot (10 of travel: on one spool B pays out 9.5 mm less than A over the 150, the 0.81 ribbon between them, tools/probe_mast_sim.py), the ribbon's loop; 15 Nov prototype (a tab post snapped on the bench print, the cradle would not go on): the SG90 slid into a closed ring, its two self-tappers into 11.5 deep columns; the idler an M3 x 10 in a heat-set insert in the bracket, turning in the cradle's 3.3 bore; assembly order parts/scout_v4_head_lib.py; PCTG

parts.name: probe turret: housing, throat, drum and the roof's middle node RM (PCTG, generated: parts/scout_v4_probe_turret)
parts.note: side plates round the spool and the drum, the N20's cheeks, the roller's rod guides and its leaf pocket, the throat up to the head's seat, RM's rod sockets; TPU lip 1, wires 1 (E); PCTG

parts.name: probe spool with its 40 T gear (drawn: parts/scout_v4_probe_spool/make.py)
parts.note: hub O28 between O31.8 flanges 19.6 apart, the 40 T gear (module 0.8, x -0.35, generated involute) outside the +y one, the drum's hub O8 outside the -y one; the stack (blade A outside, the 0.81 ribbon, blade B on the hub) wound 1.6 turns to O31.4 for the 150 mm; its three ends epoxied in one 1.4 slot at 45 deg into the hub, the ribbon on through the hub to the drum; turns on an M3 x 40; PCTG, gear face down

parts.name: probe pinion, 12 T, on the N20's 3 mm D shaft (drawn: parts/scout_v4_probe_pinion/make.py)
parts.note: x +0.35 (no undercut), centres 20.9 from the spool's (14 Nov: the coupon's G2, untried: check the mesh on the bench); D bore 3.3 / 2.8 (one past the coupon's D3) pressed on with CA; PCTG

parts.name: N20 6 V 100 rpm gear motor (B07MZH851L; replaces the 300 rpm B0BZDC951L)
parts.note: the same body: 37 long (can 17 x O12, 3 mm D shaft 10); under the spool and the drum facing +y, in a pocket through the deck; the coil's own unwind is ~100 N mm on the spool and winding in needs up to ~170 (sims): the 300 rpm stalls at ~140 through 40 / 12, the 100 rpm at ~420 (E); ~4.5 s for the 150; parked: the DRV8833 in brake, the head seated (the coil's push is ~35 N mm at the gearbox)

parts.name: the head's cable, coiled loosely in the drum
parts.note: a flat ribbon of 6 x 30 AWG PTFE wire (Remington 30KITSTRPTFE, B0722LL645; 0.81 thick, 4.9 wide (12 Nov: type E 30 AWG, OD 0.032 in, E), kapton-bound; the 26 AWG pair made it 1.2 and the blades' fight 17 mm): 5 V, GND, USB D+ / D- (side by side), the servo's signal, the LED bars' minus; the 470 uF at the servo covers its start; a JST ZH 1.5 mm 4-pin lead into the camera; up inside the lens on A, wound between the blades, its spool end through the hub into the drum's loose coil (3.5 turns of room for 1.6); the USB pair to the USB-C breakout on the Radxa

parts.name: the two blades from the spool up into the throat
parts.note: two 19 mm (3/4 in) steel tape strips, 0.2 m each with 0.15 m used, cut from the Topzone 16 ft tape (B00ZMHXV4I; its case and spring not used), curves facing (~22 g/m, E); spool ends set in printed clamp slots with epoxy, tip ends with an O2.2 hole each for the head's M2s (a carbide bit or a punch: hardened steel); their mass is all here

parts.name: the coil's pressure roller (drawn: parts/scout_v4_probe_roller/make.py): two printed O8 x 4.50 tubes turning on a O3 carbon rod 23.6 long (bore 3.3, no bearings), between them a printed saddle on the rod carrying a Keystone-209-type leaf contact (ZCZQC B0C5D3XLBK) against the pocket's fixed end wall
parts.note: 15 deg before the exit, the rod's ends guided in radial slots of two walls at |y| 9.8..12 (14 Nov: the old end pockets stood in the props' keep-out), the leaf's pocket on the rod's middle; no screw: the saddle set (S1 / S2 / S3: body 2.0 / 2.5 / 2.8 over the rod) sets the force, E 3.0-8.0 N on the empty coil with S2, 3.4-9.2 with S3; the sims: a coil whose mast is pushed lifts its outer turn (blossoms) unless something locks it within ~90 deg of the exit; ~6 N locks a 2.4 N push (mu 0.3); the tubes' drag on the rod (mu 0.25 E) is ~25 N mm at the spool at the worst force, 1.32x left on the N20 at the worst stroke

assembly.note: 15 Nov (engine worker, Spark's bench print): the assembly gate, tools/assembly_check.py; fits from topo/fit.py (the probe coupon). The order: the frame and everything fixed in it; the turret with its spool, gears, N20, drum and roller from above; the rods and nodes; the head frame on the blades' tip (55); the head's steps of parts/scout_v4_head_lib.py (SG90 into the ring, the camera into the cradle in hand, the cradle lowered at nod 0 onto the horn; the M3 idler not drawn); the nod. Mates are running fits; a piece seated on a stop is held to its path's fit gap at every step past the seat. The props go on last.

contacts.why: the M3 x 5.7 heat-set inserts (drawn with the bolts) melted into the yokes' insert holes
the 40 / 12 gear mesh: the teeth are drawn at an arbitrary phase
the head's cable coil is drawn as a solid ring over the drum's O8 hub (a loose coil, nothing printed in it)
the blades leave the wound coil at its tangent (the feed drawn from the coil's surface)
the horn's hub on the SG90's spline, 0.25 off the case on the spline's shoulder (the spline itself not drawn)

mates.why: the cradle turns between the head frame's brackets
the pinion's D bore on the N20's 3.0 / 2.5 D shaft
the spool turns between the turret's side plates

paths.name: turret onto the frame
paths.why: the turret goes on as one unit with its spool, gears, N20 (into the deck's pocket), drum and roller (the DRV8833 is taped under the deck), down from above

paths.name: blades into the head frame's clip
paths.why: the two blades' tips (the lens, 2 x 2.78 thick, 19 wide) slide up into the head frame's 14 mm clip

paths.name: SG90 into the head frame's ring
paths.why: step 2 (parts/scout_v4_head_lib.py): the SG90 with its horn slid +y into the frame's closed ring from the cradle's room, its tabs stop on the ring's face

paths.name: camera into the cradle (in hand)
paths.why: step 3: the case slid into the cradle from behind until its front meets the lip, the cradle still off the head (Spark 15 Nov: it could not)

paths.name: cradle lowered onto the horn
paths.why: step 5: the cradle with the camera and LED bars at nod 0 lowered straight down between the bracket and the SG90, the horn's arm, hub and centre screw sliding up its channel from the open bottom edge; with the horn here (shown lifted out together; head_frame/make.py checks the channel over the horn)

paths.name: head nods -20..+90 deg
paths.why: the cradle, camera and LED bars about the SG90's axis from 20 down to 90 up (parked 15 up)

paths.name: FC up onto its posts
paths.why: the FC on its grommets up from below onto its 4 posts (M3 into the inserts) with the receiver off (the battery mechanism bolts on after: its room is the boards' way in), the screws' heads from below

paths.name: XR2 up onto its land
paths.why: the XR2 taped up from below onto its land beside the FC with the receiver off (the battery mechanism bolts on after: its room is the boards' way in)

paths.name: DRV8833 up onto its land
paths.why: the DRV8833 taped up from below onto its land beside the FC with the receiver off (the battery mechanism bolts on after: its room is the boards' way in)

paths.name: Radxa up onto its posts
paths.why: the Radxa up from below onto its 4 posts (M2.5 into the inserts) with the receiver off (the battery mechanism bolts on after: its room is the boards' way in), the screws' heads from below; its tail third through the tail tray's window, before the UBEC (which hangs under it)

paths.name: UBEC up into its pod
paths.why: the UBEC taped up under its two end lands in the pod below the tail tray, after the Radxa (it closes the Radxa's way in)

paths.name: flow sensor up into its pod
paths.why: the MTF-02P taped up under its land in the nose pod, open below
